cohort: 6579 births at two reference hospitals in the public network of Federal District/Brazil during 2013
finding: The C-section rates were high at both hospitals, with the highest rates observed in Robson groups G5, G1, and G2, indicating a need to reduce cesarean rates in these groups.
mod_finding: This study investigated C-section rates and found variations between two hospitals, with higher rates observed in specific Robson groups, including those with previous C-sections.
